sources.title: Visa regime for citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan
sources.officialityEvidence: Kazakhstan MFA publishes this live passport-type table and distinguishes ordinary passports, but its bare visa labels do not establish actual issuance timing for the scoped destinations.
sources.supportingExcerpt: D – diplomatic passport; S – service/official passport; N – ordinary passport.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa service
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's live state e-government page proves electronic issuance but publishes no Kazakh ordinary-passport eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Interior Ministry portal proves pre-travel PDF issuance but asks applicants to determine eligibility without publishing a Kazakh passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.
